provenance_note: All fixtures in this directory are synthetic test captures. Under no circumstances may synthetic fixtures be interpreted as canonical official Binance evidence or used to declare production source_audit_passed=true.

synthetic_delisting_capture_bundle.jsonl.description: Standard synthetic capture bundle containing 1 list capture and multiple detail observations covering single-symbol, multi-symbol, mixed-market, unstated restriction, and malformed samples.

synthetic_malformed_capture_bundle.jsonl.description: Bundle containing malformed JSON lines and invalid base64 payloads to test fail-closed parser defenses.

synthetic_injection_attempt_bundle.jsonl.description: Bundle containing caller-injected derived fields (e.g. pre-calculated settlement_time_ms, live_observed) to test rejection of caller-supplied authority.
